name: PSP
recent: PSP Energy Berhad 于2026年11月25日公布截至2026年9月30日止第一季度业绩，净利按年增长95.3%至790万令吉，营收按年增长61.4%。公司将于2026年12月18日召开第二届常年股东大会。此外，董事Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar在2026年8月至10月期间多次减持公司股份。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止第一季度业绩，净利按年增长95.3%至790万令吉。
将于2026年12月18日召开第二届常年股东大会。
董事Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar在2026年8月至10月期间多次减持公司股份。
risks: 董事Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar在2026年8月至10月期间多次减持公司股份。
常年股东大会将审议豁免股东法定优先认购权及发行新股的议案。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为3.162亿令吉，净利为933万令吉，净利率3.0%；营收环比增长13.1%，净利环比增长33.5%，上一季度净利率为2.5%。

recent_en: PSP Energy Berhad announced its first quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with net profit up 95.3% year-on-year to RM7.9 million and revenue up 61.4% year-on-year. In addition, Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares in the company multiple times between August and October 2026.
notable_en: Announced first quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 95.3% year-on-year to RM7.9 million.
Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares in the company multiple times between August and October 2026.
risks_en: Director Puan Rafidah binti Bahtiar disposed of shares in the company multiple times between August and October 2026.
The Annual General Meeting will consider a proposed waiver of shareholders' statutory pre-emptive rights and authority to issue new shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM316.229 million and net profit was RM9.332 million, with a net margin of 3.0%; revenue grew 13.1% quarter-on-quarter and net profit grew 33.5% quarter-on-quarter, with the previous quarter's net margin at 2.5%.
